_: What the page asks of the people's models (docs/SEAMS.md, 'A new avatar set'). Held by tools/people_contract.py against web/assets/people/people.json, the models it names and the people cities/shibuya/city.json casts. A set that keeps this may replace the one in use without the story being played: tools/check.sh runs this, look and mem.

units.origin: between the feet, on the ground

bones._: Logical names the code asks for (people.js alias()); the index's `bones` map gives each the set's own bone name, as three.js names it (spaces to underscores). Each must be a joint of every model.

by_pattern._: Found by the end of their name; each pattern must match one joint

grip._: The hand's grip for what is carried (people.js): for each hand of the alias's prefix, these fingers

materials._: By the end of their name: the body (its texture's alpha marks skin from cloth) and the head; hair cards end _opacity

heroes._: Who you play: index heroes.characters. Clips are in the model itself.

npcs._: Everyone else: index npcs.characters, one model each, no clips in it. The clips are shared, one file a sex (index npcs.clips), bound by bone name: every bone a clip drives must be a node of every model of that sex.
npcs.cast_clips: every look.clip the map's people are cast with (cities/shibuya/city.json game.npcs[].look.clip) is in their sex's file

cast_clips_known._: Cast with a clip their sex's file has not, and so standing in Idle (people.js play()); to be built or recast

face._: A model the index gives a `face` has a mesh with these shapes (face.js)

far._: The crowd's far copy (index crowd_cast.file): a node for each of the crowd's cast and its coarse copy; pipeline/crowd_cast.py --check holds it

guide._: The guide dog (city.json story guide.model; companion.js): looks along +x, its size taken from its own box
